note: STAGING ONLY. A controlled shop fixture for judging the customer-facing UX: 21 canonical figures, 26 stock positions, every public shop state the product can show. Contains no production stock, no real purchase costs, no customer data. Quantities are invented, small and deliberately unrealistic; they exist to produce a state on screen, not to describe a shelf. Applied by tools/seed-shop-fixtures.mts, which refuses to run anywhere but staging.
